transcript: Speaker A: It's not Vitamin, it's Vi-tuh-min. It's not burger, it's Bur-guh. It's not Police, it's Puh-lees. It's not Career, it's Kuh-reer. It's not Privacy, it's Pri-vuh-see. ऐसी गलतियों की वजह से हम दूसरों के सामने इंग्लिश बोलने में शाई फील करते हैं। [Because of such mistakes, we feel shy speaking English in front of others.] But इसका परफेक्ट सोल्यूशन है SpeakEasy App। [But its perfect solution is the SpeakEasy App.] इस ऐप पर एक Vani AI नाम की रोबोट है जो आपसे दोस्त की तरह लाइव बातें करेगी। [On this app, there is a robot named Vani AI who will talk to you live like a friend.] क्योंकि वो रोबोट है तो कोई शर्म नहीं, कोई डर नहीं। [Since it's a robot, there's no shame, no fear.] आप जो भी लाइन या वर्ड बोलोगे वो रियल टाइम फीडबैक देगी कि उसे सही और कॉन्फिडेंट वे में कैसे बोलना है। [Whatever line or word you speak, it will give real-time feedback on how to say it correctly and confidently.] कितनी इंफॉर्मेटिव वीडियो थी ना? [What an informative video, right?] शर्माना छोड़ो और अभी नीचे दिए बटन पर क्लिक करके SpeakEasy App डाउनलोड करो। [Stop being shy and click the button below to download the SpeakEasy App now.] ट्रायल सिर्फ ₹1 में है। [The trial is for just ₹1.] गलतियों का डर छोड़ो, लाइव बात करना शुरू करो। [Leave the fear of mistakes, start talking live.] Install Now पर क्लिक करें। [Click Install Now.] Speaker B: अभी SpeakEasy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: It's not Vitamin / it's Vi-tuh-min / It's not burger / it's Bur-guh / It's not Police / it's Puh-lees / It's not Career / it's Kuh-reer / It's not Privacy / it's Pri-vuh-see / Aisi galatiyon ki vajah se hum dusron ke samne English bolne mein shy feel karte hain. / But iska perfect solution hai SpeakEasy App. / Iss app par ek Vani AI naam ki robot hai jo aapsey dost ki tarah live baaten karegi. / Kyunki vo robot hai toh koi sharm nahi, koi dar nahi. / Aap jo bhi line ya word bologe vo real time feedback degi ki usey sahi aur confident way mein kaise bolna hai. / Kitni informative video thi na? / Sharmana chhodo aur abhi neeche diye button par click karke SpeakEasy App download karo. / Trial sirf ₹1 mein hai. / Galatiyon ka dar chhodo. / Live baat karna shuru karo. / Install Now par click karein. / Speakeasy AI / Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy / Install Now / GET IT ON Google Play
summary: The presenter highlights common English pronunciation errors that cause social anxiety. He introduces the SpeakEasy App, which features an AI companion named Vani to help users practice speaking without judgment. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
